dslRule:
/*!
<!id: explicit.unboxing.character.array>
<!description: Make explicit unboxing of Character to char when assigning to a char array element.>
<!severity: INFO>
*/
$array[$index$] = $charObject :: instanceof($array, "char[]") && instanceof($charObject, "java.lang.Character")
=>
$array[$index$] = $charObject.charValue()
;;
